form_factor.reason_not_computed: the published regression was mis-transcribed and gave 1+k = 279.7; deleted rather than fitted to look right
form_factor.action_required: evaluate (1+k) from a transcribed-and-unit-tested Katsui or Holtrop implementation, or determine it from a model test per ITTC low-Froude-number extrapolation, or by CFD

R_wave.method: declared planning allowance, NOT a regression evaluation
R_wave.action_required: replace with a verified wave-resistance method, model test, or parent-ship correlation before any warranty is offered

propulsion.action_required: replace with self-propulsion analysis or model test

powering.confidence: PRELIMINARY - wave resistance, wake, thrust deduction and propeller efficiency are declared estimates, not computed values

attained_edi.note: P_ME should be the MCR at which V_ref is measured; if the engine is derated, V_ref must be consistent with that derating

edi_margin.sensitivity: a 10% power underestimate moves attained EEDI by -10%; the declared ESTIMATE-class wave and propulsor terms are larger than that, so this margin is indicative only

options: reduce contract speed (cheapest, costs schedule on the trade)
larger DWT for the same hull (raises the reference line: required EEDI ~ DWT^-0.4778)
energy-saving device / propeller boss cap fins (f_w credit where applicable)
shaft generator and waste-heat recovery to cut P_AE
dual-fuel or LNG (different C_f, and a different rule path entirely)
edi_trade_study.caveat: installed MCR itself rests on ESTIMATE-class wave resistance and propulsor efficiency; this trade study is directional only

rule_set.name: IACS CSR (Bulk Carriers & Oil Tankers), harmonised rule framework
rule_set.edition: MUST be confirmed against the current CSR release at submission

swbm.method: direct double integration of the load and buoyancy curves, free-free end conditions

fe_crosscheck.method_b: Euler-Bernoulli beam FE (consistent + nodal loads, projection)
fe_crosscheck.note: two discretisations of the same ODE; disagreement localises quadrature, load-application or sign errors that neither method shows alone

wave_bm.reason: the vertical wave bending moment coefficient could not be transcribed reliably from memory; three attempts gave 1.52e8, 152 and 3.52e5 kNm against a parent-ship expectation of ~2e6 kNm for L = 180 m

gates_that_caught_it.order_of_magnitude_gate: C_w in [2.0, 10.75] and M_vw in the parent-ship band [8.0e5, 6.0e7] kNm; an order-of-magnitude gate is the only reliable net for unit and coefficient errors of 10^3

wave_bm.action_required: read the vertical wave bending moment formula, the wave coefficient and the hull-girder stress acceptance criterion from the CSR edition in force, or obtain M_vw from a class-approved tool (DNV Nauticus Hull, ABS hull-girder tools, LR), then re-run this module

required_Z.reason: M_vw is OPEN, so the total hull-girder moment cannot be formed

midship_section.note: longitudinal own second moments and the shear-lag reduction of wide flanges are neglected; CSR requires both and both reduce the modulus

items.name: strength deck stringer (both sides)
items.note: 6 m wide deck stringer each side of the hatch

items.name: side shell plating (both sides)
items.note: bilge to deck less 2 m at each end

items.name: bottom girder and floors
items.note: centre girder plus two side girders

midship_section.provenance: ESTIMATE - every plate thickness and longitudinal spacing is a declared preliminary value, not a rule-derived scantling

check.reason: M_vw is OPEN, so the total hull-girder moment cannot be formed
check.parent_band_note: a Handysize bulk carrier of this length typically has a net deck section modulus of 1.4e7 - 2.0e7 cm3

exploration.reason: selected: clears the composite threshold with every sub-score above its floor

config.note: calibration is provisional: piecewise-linear anchors should be fitted to real ships of this type before the gate is used to reject a design

exploration.caveat: capacity, steel intensity and power intensity use proxy measures (section-area scaling and a crude wetted-surface estimate); fatigue life and yard-limit constructability are NOT SCORED. The ranking is directional until those are real computations.

steel_takeoff.accuracy: class 5 order-of-magnitude; +/-20% until calibrated on a parent ship
